honing_confound: Hypersync Mode damage scaling and cooldown reduction from on-hit Sync skill effects are gear-indexed. At T4, faster Hypersync re-entry compounds with damage ceiling for significant uptime advantage.

delivery.evidence: Machinist uses a high-tech drone + personal weapons. Normal skills: laser weapons, high-tech gadgets. Sync skills (Hypersync exclusive): fast laser attacks with low cooldowns. Drone Joint skills: combined drone+caster attack patterns.

footprint.evidence: Laser weapon attacks are narrow beams or point-impact. Sync skills are fast narrow-beam attacks. Drone attacks at target location. No wide-zone AoE identity.

geo_text: Evolutionary Legacy Machinist centers on Hypersync Mode (Z identity) — a drone-suit transformation that enables Sync skills. In Hypersync: Sync skills deal +2-6% damage per hit (max 3 stacks), reduce cooldowns by -0.5s per hit. 40% Core Energy refunded on early cancellation. Outside Hypersync: normal Machinist skill rotation to fill Core Battery.

control.evidence: Machinist kit is damage-focused. No CC identity.

defense.evidence: Medium armor type. Good mobility from high-tech movement tools.

economy.resource_verbatim: Core Battery (Identity Gauge) + Hypersync Mode sub-resources
economy.builder_source: Normal skills, Drone skills, Joint skills fill Core Battery. Core Battery depletes in Hypersync Mode.
economy.plain_text: HYPERSYNC MODE ECONOMY: Core Battery fills via all skills → Z key enters Hypersync Mode → Core Battery depletes while active. SYNC SKILLS in Hypersync: on-hit grant +2-6% damage (max 3 stacks) and reduce skill cooldowns by -0.5s each hit. EVOLUTIONARY LEGACY BONUS: 40% Core Energy refunded on cancellation → allows more frequent Hypersync cycling by canceling before full depletion for efficient refund. Strategy: enter Hypersync → stack Sync skill damage buff → cancel at optimal point for 40% refund → re-enter faster.

element.evidence: Machinist uses advanced technology weapons — lasers, tech gadgets. Damage type: Physical/Tech.

movement.evidence: Moderate mobility. Some Machinist skills include built-in movement. Better mobility than Artillerist.

attr.evidence: Medium-range tech weapons. Not pure melee; not as long-range as Sharpshooter.

range.evidence: Laser weapons and Drone attacks: medium to long range. Some skills extend to 25m.

tempo.evidence: Evolutionary Legacy = burst identity: Hypersync Mode is the burst phase, normal skills are the build phase. Cancel-and-re-enter optimization creates rapid burst cycling.

amp.value: Hypersync Sync skills: +2-6% damage per hit (max 3 stacks); cooldown reduction -0.5s per hit; Evolutionary Legacy: 40% Core Energy refund on cancel
amp.evidence: Directly sourced: 'During Hypersync Mode, Sync skills on hit inflict Damage +2% to +6% (Max 3 stacks) and Cooldown -0.5s; Hypersync Mode returning 40% of its Core Energy cost when canceled.'

proxy.evidence: Drone acts as a companion/proxy that enables Joint skills (combined Machinist+Drone attacks). Drone is a persistent attachment that aids in combat.

commitment.evidence: Sync skills in Hypersync are described as 'fast laser attacks with low cooldowns' — short commitment windows.

mechanics_notes: 1) The 40% CANCEL REFUND mechanic (Evolutionary Legacy) is unique in LA: intentionally canceling Hypersync Mode before full depletion refunds 40% Core Energy, enabling faster re-entry. This creates an optimization game around the 'correct cancel point' — too early = wasted Hypersync time; too late = full Core depletion, slow re-entry. 2) DRONE AS PROXY: Machinist's Drone is a persistent attached companion (not a deployable summon but a mounted tech companion). Joint skills use the Drone as a co-attacker. This is a 'mount-proxy' archetype rather than 'deployable summon.' 3) The cooldown reduction on-hit mechanic (-.0.5s per Sync hit) inside Hypersync creates a scaling rotation — the more hits you land in Hypersync, the faster your cooldowns cycle. Maximum value in a target-rich or stationary boss environment. 4) Machinist is the game's 'tech fantasy' class — drones, lasers, power suits. Identity is transformation into a powered-armor mode (Hypersync) for peak output.
stabilization_patch: Evolutionary Legacy (Hypersync focus) has been the dominant Machinist identity since launch. Arthetinean Skill is a secondary alternative.
tier_standing_current: C-tier (Manillagames January 2026: Machinist listed as C-tier). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Hypersync damage ceiling at T4 is competitive but the class overall is underperforming in current meta relative to tier expectations.

honing_confound: Drone and Joint skill damage scales with Tech Power (Magic attack power) from gear honing. Battery Max +10-20% (Arthetinean bonus) extends drone attachment time — more attachment = more honing-indexed drone damage.

delivery.evidence: Arthetinean Skill emphasizes Drone and Joint skills — these are drone-centric attacks where the Drone acts at target location or in concert with the Machinist. Normal skills still contribute but Drone/Joint are primary.

footprint.evidence: Drone acts at its attachment point (near Machinist) while Joint skills create dual-position attacks. Multi-point from caster + drone positions.

geo_text: Arthetinean Skill Machinist maximizes drone attachment and drone/joint skill damage. Drone is ATTACHED to the Machinist (not deployed to a distance) — acts as a combat companion in close proximity. Joint skills combine Machinist and Drone in synchronized attacks. Hypersync is AVAILABLE but is explicitly a damage loss to use — the identity deprioritizes the transformation for drone-skill synergy.

control.evidence: Same as Evolutionary Legacy. No CC identity.

economy.resource_verbatim: Core Battery (+ Battery Max increased 10-20% by Arthetinean Skill)
economy.builder_source: Drone and Joint skills fill Core Battery. Arthetinean Skill: +10-20% Battery Max (more drone attachment time). Hypersync is actively avoided.
economy.plain_text: DRONE-ATTACHED ECONOMY: Arthetinean Skill increases Core Battery max capacity (more potential Hypersync time) but the identity deprioritizes Hypersync use. Instead: maintain Drone attachment → use Drone and Joint skills → cycle on cooldowns. Drone attached = +10% Move Speed (Arthetinean bonus). Economy is cooldown-based cycling of Drone/Joint skills with Drone persistently attached.

element.evidence: Same tech class. Drone attacks may have distinct damage types.

movement.evidence: Arthetinean Skill grants +10% Move Speed when Drone is attached — better mobility than Evolutionary Legacy's Hypersync focus. One of the more mobile Machinist builds.

attr.evidence: Same medium-range profile. Drone attachment (proximity) means attacks occur near caster.

tempo.evidence: Arthetinean Skill is sustained: drone-attached constant output rather than Hypersync burst windows.

amp.value: Drone/Joint skills +15-25% damage; Battery Max +10-20%; +10% Move Speed while Drone attached
amp.evidence: Directly sourced: 'increases damage of Drone and Joint skills by 15-25%, increases Battery Max by 10-20%, and increases Move Speed by 10% when a Drone is attached.'

proxy.evidence: Drone is the proxy entity — attached companion that participates in Joint skills. More explicit drone-as-proxy than Evolutionary Legacy (which uses Drone in Sync skills within Hypersync).

commitment.evidence: Joint skills likely have wind-up animations for the combined Machinist+Drone attack sequences.

mechanics_notes: 1) 'Hypersync is a damage loss to use' is a stark identity definition: the transformation mode that IS the other identity's focus becomes actively COUNTERPRODUCTIVE here. This is the most explicit 'do not use that' identity instruction in LA. 2) Arthetinean Skill makes the Drone the PRIMARY delivery mechanism — a persistent attached proxy. The Machinist becomes a 'drone operator' class rather than a 'powered-suit' class. These are genuinely different gameplay philosophies on the same base class. 3) +10% Move Speed from drone attachment is a meaningful advantage — one of the few cases where staying in the non-transformation state grants a mobility benefit (vs the general pattern of transformation-states granting bonuses). 4) The Arthetinean Skill identity has lower peak ceiling than Evolutionary Legacy's optimized Hypersync cancel-cycling, making it the lower-skill-floor 'accessible' choice.
stabilization_patch: Arthetinean Skill has been secondary to Evolutionary Legacy throughout Machinist's history.
tier_standing_current: C-tier (same class tier as Evolutionary Legacy). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Drone damage scaling is consistent and not as ceiling-constrained as Hypersync burst — less confound but also less variance.
